predictor.notes: Best validated low-complexity predictor: two approximately continuous affine regimes. It exactly matches the approved prices at quantities 50 and 200. Applying the disclosed 1.08 quantization to its predictions also reproduces all eight estimates, at quantities 1, 300, 345, 400, 500, 750, 876 and 1000. The upper-range coefficients were selected near the center of the interval-feasible coefficient set, rather than treating rounded estimates as exact prices. A single global affine or quadratic model is inconsistent with the observations. Uncertainty remains substantial: the breakpoint at 315 is a modeling choice, not an exactly recovered threshold. Conditional on a continuous two-line model, feasible intersections span approximately 294–333 and upper slopes span approximately 64.24–93.64 pence per unit, with correlated intercept uncertainty. Other nonlinearities or discontinuities cannot be excluded. All eight distinct estimate inputs were used adaptively; the available evidence does not uniquely identify exact prices throughout 1–1000.
